description: Sheet-metal flat-pattern golden for an AUTHORED full tray / pan: a rectangular base flange (40 x 30 mm) + FOUR full-width edge flanges, one folded off EACH base edge (a depth-1 bend STAR of N=4, docs/design/sheet-metal.md §4.3; §6; §9 goldens #1/#2/#4). This is the headline 'full tray/pan' claim the corner-tray (N=2) golden only half-exercises: all four arms develop in 2D (a plus/cross), every flange still folds INDEPENDENTLY off the fixed base (no graph relaxation), and the four full-width arms MEET at the four base corners so the developed outline is a single closed 12-edge loop. Both diagonal pairs of arms share corners; the measured fused volume is EXACTLY the analytic sum of base + four flanges (residual 0.0), the geometric proof the arms do NOT overlap in 3D at any corner — full-width N=4 is in scope, not a wall.
tangent_line_convention: Each leg is measured to its bend TANGENT LINE (§9 #1). The base develops to its 40 x 30 flat top face; the +X-edge flange (bend axis +Y) develops to 20 mm, the -X-edge flange to 15 mm, the +Y-edge flange (bend axis +X) to 25 mm, the -Y-edge flange to 10 mm. Four bend allowances REPLACE the four sharp-corner setbacks.
derivation: HAND-DERIVED analytic values (geometry-gates skill). Dims: base 40 (X) x 30 (Y) mm; flanges off the +X / -X edges develop legs 20 / 15 mm (width 30, along the +Y bend axis); flanges off the +Y / -Y edges develop legs 25 / 10 mm (width 40, along the +X bend axis); gauge t = 2 mm, inner bend radius r = 3 mm, all four bends 90 deg, K = 0.44 (v1 default).
Bend allowance (§1), same for all four 90-deg bends at r=3, t=2, K=0.44: BA = (pi/2)*(3 + 0.44*2) = 6.094689747964199 mm.

Developed area (§9 #2, the model-agnostic invariant): flat_area = base_area + SUM(flange developed areas) + SUM(bend-strip areas), the SHARED base counted ONCE. = (40*30) + (20*30 + 15*30 + 25*40 + 10*40) + BA*(30 + 30 + 40 + 40) = 1200 + (600+450+1000+400) + BA*140 = 3650 + 853.256... = 4503.256564714988 mm^2. Holds for the 2D plus blank exactly as for a 1D strip.

Bounding-box envelope of the 2D plus blank: one frame extent = base 30 + (BA + 25 leg of the +Y flange) + (BA + 10 leg of the -Y flange) = 30 + 2*BA + 35 = 77.1893794959284 mm; the other = base 40 + (BA + 20 leg of the +X flange) + (BA + 15 leg of the -X flange) = 40 + 2*BA + 35 = 87.1893794959284 mm. (Which physical axis maps to frame-X vs frame-Y is a fixed deterministic choice, not a correctness property; the AREA invariant and per-arm widths are.)

Outline: the union boundary of the base + four full-width arms is a plus/cross. With a flange on EVERY base edge, no base side survives as a free cut edge; each arm contributes its three outer edges (two sides + far) = 4 * 3 = 12 body edges, and adjacent arms meet exactly at the four base corners, so the 12 edges chain into ONE closed loop. Four fold lines (one per bend) = 4 bend edges. The four empty corner squares are documented v1 simplifications (no corner relief -- §7 deferred).

All four flanges fold to the +normal side of the base -> direction 'up' for every bend (§5 inference). Each fold line spans its flange's width: the +X/-X flanges' folds span the 30 mm width, the +Y/-Y flanges' the 40 mm width.

Fused body volume (analytic, EXACTLY additive): base plate (40*30*2 = 2400) + each flange (leg*t + quarter-annulus (pi/4)*(outer^2 - inner^2) = 4*pi, at outer=5 inner=3) times its width. +X: (20*2 + 4*pi)*30; -X: (15*2 + 4*pi)*30; +Y: (25*2 + 4*pi)*40; -Y: (10*2 + 4*pi)*40. Total = 9059.291886010284 mm^3. The measured volume equals this to residual 0.0 -- the four arms fold in disjoint directions and do NOT overlap in 3D at any corner, the geometric proof full-width N=4 is tractable.

content_hash is the sha256 of the provenance-driven FlatPattern.to_json_bytes() -- a DETERMINISM PIN reproducible in-process AND across a fresh interpreter restart (§9 #4), version-pinned to OCCT/build123d (arc-fit FP). A change without a kernel-version bump is a determinism regression (P0), never a retry.
tolerance_rationale: Measured first, then set. Measured deviations vs hand-derived (2026-07-19, build123d 0.11.1 / OCCT 7.9): flat_area residual ~9e-13, flat_length/bend_width residuals ~1e-14, BA residuals ~1e-14 (arc-fit inner radii carry FP noise ~1e-15..1e-14). Ceiling 1e-9 gives ~3-4 orders of headroom for platform FP variation while staying tighter than the kernel linear tolerance (1e-7 m). Volume tolerance 1e-6 absorbs arc-fit noise scaled by width (measured volume residual 0.0).
